description: New illustrated battle composition using existing game character references, not a gameplay screenshot.

prompts.app:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original square mobile game app-icon concept for Union of Kingdoms, featuring a dramatic troop-versus-boss fight based on the game's actual approved character graphics. Input image roles: image 1 is ONLY the design reference for DK / Deathkar, the ivory-and-gold horned boss with violet rune hammer and glowing purple eyes. Image 2 is ONLY the guardian infantry design reference, silver helmet, blue plume/scarf, large blue-and-gold kite shield, small gem warhammer. Image 3 is ONLY the fire archer design reference, white-haired elf woman in red hood, real crescent-ended wooden BOW with drawn fire arrow. Image 4 is ONLY the shadow cavalry design reference, pale-haired masked purple-hooded rider on dark stag with violet antlers, holding crescent polearm. Create a NEW action composition with these SAME recognizable character designs, not a comparison sheet or lineup.
Scene: a close battle on the game's muted sage-green meadow with warm earthy path, only softly simplified tree silhouettes and a hint of a blue-roofed kingdom wall in the far background. The actual fight is the unmistakable main subject. Full-bleed opaque square artwork, no white tile, no rounded corners, no UI frame, no letters or wordmark. Single dynamic well-organized composition: Deathkar dominates the right half, his horned helmet and chest clearly visible. He swings his ONE large violet-rune warhammer DOWN-LEFT into the guardian's raised BLUE KITE SHIELD in the center. One clean warm gold-and-violet contact burst shows precisely where the hammer head strikes the shield. The small brave guardian braces in the lower-left foreground, with his face/helmet visible above and behind the shield; his own small gem hammer is held low at his side, distinctly separate from the boss's weapon. Behind him on the upper-left, the red-hooded fire archer aims a real wooden BOW toward Deathkar's chest, pulling its string with her drawing hand and using the other hand to grip the bow. Arrow nock meets string at drawing fingers; bowstring forms a believable V under tension; exactly one flaming arrow on the string, no crossbow. The shadow stag rider charges from the middle-left background toward the boss, recognizable masked rider and violet antlers, less prominent than the foreground clash but fully clear, with clean separated silhouettes and limbs.
Composition requirements: boss face, guardian helmet, entire meaningful shield silhouette and main impact inside the central 75 percent of the square. Give horns, bow, antlers and weapons breathing room. Prefer large expressive readable character masses and strong diagonals, with blue troops against the violet boss and red archer providing a controlled accent. Background muted and quiet, no competing fireworks or elaborate palace. Exactly one boss plus these three troop types, no crowd of extra characters. Weapons must not cut through unrelated faces or hands.
Art direction: hand-drawn flat 2D chibi fantasy game illustration, oversized heads and short strong limbs, bold dark espresso-brown outlines, large soft slightly exaggerated forms, clear silhouettes, restrained broad two-tone cel shading, warm ivory armour, saturated blue/red/purple role colours, gold accents. Match the source character illustrations. Keep materials illustrated rather than realistic: no gloss, metallic reflections, photographic textures, painted gritty realism, 3D render or glass. Preserve the boss's violet rune identity and magical rim as restrained accents, without obscuring his face or weapon.
Critical anatomy: boss has exactly two connected arms and two hands, exactly one hand firmly gripping a clearly visible continuous brown hammer handle with fingers and opposing thumb, natural wrist-to-forearm-to-elbow connection, normal perpendicular hammer head, other fist held close to his torso. Guardian has two arms: shield arm behind shield, weapon hand correctly grips his own hammer. Archer has two hands with physically correct bow-and-string grip. Rider has exactly two arms and the stag has four anatomically consistent legs. No duplicate hands, floating weapon shafts or merged bodies. No blood, gore, text, watermark or border. Output one polished single square app-icon concept showing the decisive battle moment.
prompts.favicon: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: small transparent browser favicon concept paired with the Union of Kingdoms troop-versus-Deathkar battle app icon. Input image 1 is the approved guardian unit design reference; preserve its BLUE KITE SHIELD identity. Input image 2 is the new battle composition reference, used only for the blue shield, warm gold border, white spear-star rune and restrained violet impact colour. Create ONE extremely simplified stand-alone guardian shield emblem. Broad royal-blue kite shield, wide warm-gold rim, thick dark espresso outline, rounded upper shoulders and one broad pointed lower tip. The blue interior has one large SIMPLE WHITE spear/star rune, with only a few broad strokes, visually centered. One small bold violet lightning/impact notch at the upper-right edge suggests the DK hammer collision, keep it a single simple graphic shape, no particle cloud. Frontal three-quarter stance only very slight so shape remains clear. Flat hand-drawn 2D cartoon fantasy game art, soft chunky shapes, quiet flat surfaces and TWO broad shading values maximum. Designed for 16x16 and 32x32 browser icon readability: generous bold shape, no rivets, no filigree, no little gold diamond decorations, no hand, no face, no hammer, no scenery, no text, no frame. Emblem fills central 86 percent of square height and around 72 percent of width, all edges visible and no cropping. TRUE TRANSPARENT background with alpha, no drawn checkerboard or white tile, no shadow outside the silhouette, no watermark, no photoreal metal or glossy 3D. One finished isolated favicon master.
